image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a printed paper menu. The text is heavily distorted and illegible, appearing as gibberish characters rather than real words. The layout mimics a standard restaurant menu with columns for items and prices, but the content is nonsensical. There are faint decorative elements or logos at the top right.

artifact_observations.location: Throughout the entire text body of the menu
artifact_observations.reasoning: The primary function of a menu is readable text. The AI has generated pseudo-text that looks like letters but forms no valid words or sentences. This is a catastrophic failure for this class.

artifact_observations.location: Edges of the paper and background
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/blur around the edges of the paper, typical of AI generation struggling with sharp document boundaries against a background.
The decorative elements/logos are melted and indistinct, lacking the sharp vector-like quality usually seen in printed branding.

If the text is completely nonsensical, the alignment score should be heavily penalized regardless of the visual resemblance to a paper sheet. Verify if the 'logos' are actually coherent symbols or just melted shapes.
